content.value_statement: Teams need consistent public documentation without guessing the Fumadocs file layout. This skill guides Claude, Codex, and Claude Code to create MDX pages, frontmatter, and meta.json navigation.
actual_capabilities: Explains the src/content/docs folder structure for Fumadocs pages.
Defines required MDX frontmatter fields for title, description, and icon.
Shows how meta.json controls sidebar order, icons, separators, and root sections.
Provides examples for basic MDX documentation pages and folder metadata.
References supported Fumadocs UI components such as Callout, Tabs, and Steps.
limitations: It does not generate or run build commands.
It assumes the project already uses Fumadocs and MDX.
It does not validate icon names or frontmatter against the running app.
It does not cover private API authentication or deployment setup.

use_cases.title: Add Product Onboarding Docs
use_cases.description: Create a new getting started page with clear headings, frontmatter, and links to the next setup steps.

use_cases.title: Organize Documentation Navigation
use_cases.description: Plan folder metadata so sidebar groups, page order, icons, and separators are consistent.

use_cases.title: Structure API Reference Pages
use_cases.description: Create an API section with introduction, authentication, endpoints, and advanced topics.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Basic Page
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner request for one documentation page.
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a Fumadocs MDX page for [topic]. Use the path [path], title [title], description [description], and icon [icon]. Include clear sections and internal links.

prompt_templates.title: Add Section Navigation
prompt_templates.prompt: Organize the docs section at [folder path]. Recommend page order, group title, icon, separators, and whether the section should be a root tab.

prompt_templates.title: Convert Notes to Docs
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate request to turn rough notes into publishable documentation.
prompt_templates.prompt: Convert these notes into a Fumadocs page for [audience]. Add frontmatter guidance, concise headings, callouts where useful, and links to related pages.

prompt_templates.title: Plan a Documentation Area
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced request for a multi-page documentation structure.
prompt_templates.prompt: Design a Fumadocs documentation area for [product or feature]. Propose folders, page names, navigation metadata, icons, and content goals for each page.

output_examples.input: Create a getting started page for installation.
output_examples.output: A new MDX page plan with title, description, icon recommendation, headings, setup steps, and links to configuration pages.

output_examples.input: Organize API docs into sidebar sections.
output_examples.output: A navigation plan listing introduction, endpoints, authentication, and a separator before advanced topics.

output_examples.input: Review a docs folder for missing metadata.
output_examples.output: A checklist of pages missing descriptions, unclear icons, weak titles, and navigation gaps.

best_practices: Provide the target page path, title, audience, and main goal before generating content.
Keep frontmatter descriptions short, specific, and useful for search results.
Update meta.json whenever adding or renaming pages so navigation stays predictable.
anti_patterns: Do not create pages outside src/content/docs unless the project uses a different docs root.
Do not choose decorative icons that obscure the page meaning.
Do not leave placeholder external links in published navigation.

faq.question: What documentation system does this skill target?
faq.answer: It targets Fumadocs projects that store MDX pages under src/content/docs.

faq.question: Can it create navigation metadata?
faq.answer: Yes. It explains how meta.json controls page order, section titles, icons, separators, root tabs, and default open state.

faq.question: Does it run commands or install packages?
faq.answer: No. The skill provides documentation structure and content guidance only.

faq.question: Can it help choose Lucide icons?
faq.answer: Yes. It can recommend Lucide icon names for page frontmatter and section metadata.

faq.question: Does it support Fumadocs UI components?
faq.answer: Yes. The reference mentions components such as Callout, Tabs, Steps, and Cards.

faq.question: What should I provide before using it?
faq.answer: Provide the topic, target audience, page path, desired title, and related pages.
